newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer after muted day.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends touch firmer after muted day.

text.p: White sugar futures closed slightly firmer on Monday but the bulk of the traded volume derived from crosses and spread dealings on the two nearby months, traders said.
One leading commission house led the way with the crossed spread trades, with the May/August spread also attracting some light broker interest.

London's spot May contract closed just 30 cents firmer at $306.50 after moving in a tight range of $1.50. August was up $1.00 at $306.30 and overall volume reached 1,321 lots, nearly all of which was in May and August.
Technically, May traded an outside day, closing marginally to the upside. Analysts said the position was moving rangebound within a contracting channel.
